continuity_invariants: The same ceramic bowl and folded cloth remain on the wooden table. The revealed pattern belongs to the bowl.

shots.opening_composition: A medium view shows a seated craftsperson beside a covered ceramic bowl on a wooden table.

phases.cue: The cloth rests over the bowl.
actions: The craftsperson takes two corners of the cloth and slowly lifts it, revealing the blue pattern on the bowl.
The craftsperson lays the cloth beside the bowl and gently turns the bowl a quarter turn to present its painted surface.

shots.pacing: The reveal is unhurried, with time to observe the pattern.
shots.end_state: The uncovered bowl faces forward with the folded cloth beside it.
shots.transition: The visible pattern carries into a closer view of the finished object.

shots.opening_composition: A close view shows the same uncovered bowl and the edge of the cloth on the table.

actions: The craftsperson withdraws both hands and quietly studies the finished bowl; reflected window light rests on its glaze.

shots.pacing: A brief still observation completes the reveal.
shots.end_state: The bowl stays upright and undisturbed on the table.
shots.transition: The clip ends on the completed display.

plan.overall_soundscape: Soft fabric rustle, ceramic contact on wood and a quiet room tone.
